text:
Josh (AE): Heads-up — customer wants one commit across multiple SKUs (embeddings + gen + rerank). Current sheet treats separately. Can we consolidate? Need quick guidance.

Priya (Pricing): Wecan. Working on a SKU consolidation model in the v3 rate sheet: define a canonical SKU and list aliases. Commits & percent-off apply to the canonical SKU.

Josh (AE): How will this show up to AEs? They need to know what counts toward the commit.

Priya (Pricing): Sales UI will surface an "Effective SKU" and show alias -> canonical mapping on quote preview. Until the UI lands, include a note in the quote text.

Tomás (Deal Desk): For customers with existing commits on old SKUs, propose a 90-day grandfather policy where legacy commits map to the new canonical SKU if the PO signed before cutover. Approve?

Aisha (Sales Ops): 90 days seems OK but we need exact PO cutoff policy and invoice labeling so AR doesn't get confused.

Priya (Pricing): Plan:
- Grandfather window: 90 days from public rate-sheet switch.
- Billing: invoice will show customer-facing alias SKU but behind the scenes ledger tags canonical SKU for quota math.
- Quote payload will include flag: normalized_pricing_applied=true when mapping used.
(Example mapping snippet for docs will be included.)

Josh (AE): Does percent-off discount cascade to aliases automatically? ACME asked about percent-off on the group.

Priya (Pricing): Yes — discount is applied at canonical level and cascades. Edge case: if aliases have non-linear list-price differences, we apply a multiplier table per alias. We'll include examples.

Tomás (Deal Desk): Action items: 1) Confirm grandfather length (90d) 2) Require PO signed date field on quotes for grandfather eligibility 3) Add normalized_pricing_applied flag to quote schema.

deploy-bot: rate-sheet-service: v3/sku-consolidation deployed to staging (build 4921) — smoke passed. https://ci.internal.redwood/builds/rs-v3-4921

Aisha (Sales Ops): Please draft a 1-pager for AEs with 3 scenarios: simple canonical mapping, alias with multiplier, and legacy-commit grandfather example. I'll circulate and attach to deal docs.

Priya (Pricing): I'll author the KB and drop sample quote JSON in #sales-docs tomorrow AM.

Josh (AE): Thanks team — I'll tell the customer we can consolidate and that legacy commits will be honored if PO signed before the cutoff. :thumbsup:
